purpose: Close ASVS V6.4.6 on the live administrative password-reset endpoint. Reachability was proved by the chain app.module.ts -> SupportModule -> support.controller.ts POST users/:userId/reset-password -> support.service.ts, so this is a live path and not dead code. It returned a value derived from the system clock in base36, stored nowhere and wired to nothing: the control was simultaneously claimed and absent, and its stub was unsafe by construction. The path now delegates initiation to PasswordResetService, and the administrator receives neither the password nor the token nor any signal about whether the account exists.
requiredInvariants: No second reset mechanism is built. Issuance, durable one-time state, bounded TTL, hash/verifier and atomic consume remain the responsibility of PasswordResetService, to which this path is wired; the register note says so rather than claiming to have reimplemented them.
The administrator receives no token, no password and no existence signal. The response is byte-identical whether the account exists, does not exist, or the lookup itself throws.

No predictable token is produced anywhere on this path, and the ABSENT_AT_PATH condition proves it. The prior expression is deliberately not quoted in a comment either, because a presence check cannot tell live code from a citation - the gate caught exactly that and the comment was reworded.
Fail-closed without the database or without the reset authority: ServiceUnavailable plus an audit record, never a simulated success. That simulation is precisely what the stub did.

Fresh MFA reuses the existing, already-applied mechanism rather than a second implementation. Only the refusal code is restated as RECENT_ADMIN_MFA_REQUIRED, because returning a settlement-flavoured code from a support endpoint would report the wrong thing; the freshness logic itself is not copied.

The delivery-boundary key is supplied by the API process from its environment. This does not widen who may trigger mail: the endpoint is already restricted by assertSupport to SUPPORT_MANAGER and ADMIN, which is stricter than a shared key.
The audit record carries the administrative initiation without the address and without any secret.
password-reset.service.ts and password-reset-token.ts are not modified and not weakened.
The cryptographic inventory is regenerated by script only. support.service.ts now reads PASSWORD_RESET_DELIVERY_KEY, so the discovery scan correctly lists it as a file touching key material.
apps/landing is not touched. No production, REG.RU, DNS, database or credential mutation.
acceptance: The response contains exactly accepted and message, and no resetToken key of any kind.
Existing account, absent account and failing lookup all produce the same response.
Missing Prisma or missing PasswordResetService raises ServiceUnavailable and records an audit entry.
A stale or absent MFA verification refuses with RECENT_ADMIN_MFA_REQUIRED before any lookup or issuance occurs.
Restoring the previous stub fails 7 of the 13 original cases; the full spec is 16/16.
V6.4.6 moves FAIL to PASS with five self-revoking conditions, all negative checks revoke, and the matrix rebuilds at applied 332 / rejected 0 with FAIL falling from 119 to 118.
